explication: This repository is a collection of Google Apps Script and WebAssembly samples, rather than one integrated application. Users invoke a sample through a spreadsheet menu, add-on interaction, custom function, or scheduled trigger; the sample processes Workspace data and may return a result to a sheet, card, chat, or log. The graph highlights documented sample families and the principal workflows visible in excerpts. Several implementations are unsampled, so their internal connections are omitted rather than inferred.
